brief: A caddy that holds two jerry cans of petrol upright in the boot of my car.

requirements.evidence: Build is 2 side-by-side full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) joined by side-connector-double; full-depth bins refused with COLLAR_IN_WAY because stacking collars occupy the rim joint. No bins/walls on build to contain cans.
requirements.requirement: Caddy holds two jerry cans upright side by side

requirements.evidence: No props for jerry cans exist in catalog (find_props for jerry/fuel/can empty); no bins placed; build is open bases only ~364x323mm footprint.
requirements.requirement: Fits in car boot and keeps cans upright in transit

requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collisions only; 3D-printed material petrol-compatibility, strength, spill containment, ventilation and automotive safety cannot be verified here.
requirements.requirement: Safe for petrol storage in car

finish.summary: Built a 2-cell connected base frame but could not seat the containing bins (rim/collar clash) within remaining turns; no jerry-can props exist for staging and petrol safety is outside the configurator scope. Requirements reported unmet.

- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
